findings.evidence: Lines 170-178: `ext μ ν; simp only [quarkKinetic_apply, mul_apply, ..., ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum, re_sum, div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.sum_mul]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ?_; rw [mul_left_comm I, mul_left_comm I, re_ofReal_mul, re_ofReal_mul]; ring`. Linearity (a) is checkable directly: `star` of `∑ α, (c α ν : ℂ) • Dψ α` gives real coefficients back via `conj_ofReal`, so each entry is `∑ α, c α ν * (I * (aα - bα)).re / 2`.
findings.fix: Factor out two lemmas and derive the theorem from them with `ext` + `mul_apply`: (a) `quarkKinetic β γ ψ (fun ν => ∑ α, (c α ν : ℂ) • Dψ α) μ ν = ∑ α, c α ν * quarkKinetic β γ ψ Dψ μ α` for real `c`, and (b) under `hS`, `quarkKinetic β γ (S *ᵥ ψ) (fun ν => S *ᵥ Dψ ν) μ ν = ∑ α, Λ α μ * quarkKinetic β γ ψ Dψ α ν`. Both are independently useful for the announced Belinfante/canonical-tensor work that will evaluate `quarkKinetic` on fields.

summary: Most proofs are short and robust, but `quarkKinetic_equivariant` hides its content in a 21-lemma `simp only` with reversed rewrites whose output shape the rest of the proof depends on, burying a reusable linearity lemma; `trace_quarkKinetic` repeats the same unfold-then-index-wise pattern.
